setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 20% pole · 5-session flag · 30% pullback on 43% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning:
# IDT Bull Flag Analysis

This is a **stock losing momentum**, not a clean flag. The flag's pullback only retraced 30% of the pole—unusually shallow—suggesting weak selling conviction, while the volume compression is modest at 43%, leaving room for the breakdown to accelerate. **Confirmation would require** a decisive close above $82.90 on expanding volume with sustained buying; **a kill would be** a close below $80.27 on volume, or a failed poke at $82.90 followed by a lower retest—both far more likely statistically given the forming pattern's poor historical edge.
